name: porkchops with a sauce
instructions:
A collection of SAUTÉED PORKCHOP recipes — the chop is the constant, the pan sauce is the variable. VARIANT A is the brown-butter sage (+ fruit axis) version, tested and excellent. VARIANT B is a DEMIGLACE version, to be developed.

=== VARIANT A — BROWN BUTTER SAGE (+ FRUIT AXIS) ===

1. SAUTÉ / BROWN the porkchops in UNSALTED BUTTER.
2. KEEP COOKING COVERED until you get BROWNED BUTTER.
3. ADD THE SAGE right before the wine stage.
4. DEGLAZE WITH WHITE WINE and keep cooking covered until the porkchops are done.

=== VARIANT B — DEMIGLACE ===

Sautéed porkchops with a demiglace-based pan sauce. To be filled in when cooked.
notes:
=== SCOPE ===

The house for sautéed porkchop + sauce combinations. Variant A (brown butter sage) is proven; variant B (demiglace) is the next direction.

=== VARIANT A — SAGE: POWDERED LOST ITS FUNK; TRY FRESH NEXT ===

Powdered sage LOST ITS FLAVOR/FUNK in this dish — maybe due to the heat? Next time: FRESH SAGE. (It goes in right before the wine stage either way.)

=== VARIANT A — WANT TO TRY: THE FRUIT AXIS ===

APRICOTS, FIGS, or the corresponding JAM/PRESERVE. Pork + sage + stone fruit/fig is a classic direction; none of it tested yet. The base is EXCELLENT even without the fruit — the fruit axis is upside, not a missing piece.

=== SIBLING RECIPES ===
